item.title: Trump leaves key questions unanswered as he seeks to calm nerves over Iran war
item.summary: There were some glaring omissions in the president's primetime address, writes the BBC's Gary O'Donoghue.

item.title: Palantir UK boss says it's up to militaries to decide how AI targeting is used in war

item.title: Over 1,800 killed since junta seized power in Burkina Faso, rights group says
item.summary: Human Rights Watch says Capt Traoré, other military leaders and jihadists "may be liable" for the killings.

item.title: Alleged Bondi gunman loses court bid to suppress names of his family
item.summary: Lawyers for Naveed Akram had argued his mother, brother and sister live in "constant fear".

item.title: Magnitude 7.4 earthquake hits off Indonesia, killing one
item.summary: The quake struck between the islands of Manado and Ternate. Tsunami warnings have now been lifted.

item.summary: Trump has criticised Nato members for showing a lack of support for US objectives in Iran.

item.summary: Trump attended the arguments in person, a rare move by a sitting president.
